title: Mountain Dining Plans: Season Dates, Carry-Over Ceilings and Statement Frequency
content:
Every plan in the Mountain Dining Plans range is sold for the 2026-27 season, whose first spendable date is 2026-11-20 and whose last spendable date is 2027-04-18. Those two dates are the same across the whole range; what differs from plan to plan is whether a balance left at the end carries into the next season, how much of it carries, how long a balance left must be used within where it does not carry, and how often the household is sent a statement.

## The season, plan by plan

| Plan | Season | First spendable date | Last spendable date |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mountain Bites Dining Card | 2026-27 | 2026-11-20 | 2027-04-18 |
| Peak Plate Dining Plan | 2026-27 | 2026-11-20 | 2027-04-18 |
| Summit Table Dining Plan | 2026-27 | 2026-11-20 | 2027-04-18 |
| Alpine Club Dining Membership | 2026-27 | 2026-11-20 | 2027-04-18 |
| Chef's Table Dining Membership | 2026-27 | 2026-11-20 | 2027-04-18 |
| Collective Hospitality Dining Membership | 2026-27 | 2026-11-20 | 2027-04-18 |

## Carry-over, post-season period and statements

The carry-over ceiling is the most balance that carries into the next season. The post-season period is the number of calendar days after the season ends within which a balance left must be used. The statement frequency is how often the household is sent a statement of the plan.

| Plan | Balance carries into next season | Carry-over ceiling | Post-season period | Statement sent |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mountain Bites Dining Card | no | $0.00 | 30 calendar days | at season end |
| Peak Plate Dining Plan | no | $0.00 | 45 calendar days | monthly |
| Summit Table Dining Plan | yes | $500.00 | 60 calendar days | monthly |
| Alpine Club Dining Membership | yes | $2000.00 | 90 calendar days | weekly |
| Chef's Table Dining Membership | yes | $6000.00 | 120 calendar days | weekly |
| Collective Hospitality Dining Membership | yes | $20000.00 | 180 calendar days | weekly |

The three tiers at the foot of the range are sent a statement either at season end or monthly; the three memberships above them weekly. Carry-over begins at the Summit Table Dining Plan, and the ceiling rises from $500.00 there to $20000.00 on the Collective Hospitality Dining Membership.
